customer_message.subject: Telephone note – rent increase after renovation, Herisau
customer_message.body:
Call from Mr Jonah Brennan, tenant of a 4-room flat at Mühlemattstrasse 65 in Herisau, landlord Stiftung Wohnen Zentral.

The Stiftung has renovated the building's roof and installed a lift this year. At an information evening, the Stiftung announced that rents would go up because of these works, by about CHF 160 per month for his flat.

Mr Brennan confirmed that he has not yet received any written notification of the increase; only the information evening.

He considers the lift to be of no use to him (ground floor) and asks whether the increase can be contested. I explained the general procedure. He will send the notification as soon as he receives it.
